title: DeviceAuthSessionRequest
description: Client proof and membership submission answering a challenge to obtain a short-lived session token.

challenge_id.description: UUID of the challenge being answered.

membership.description: Valid membership certificate of the client issued by the Home Root Authority.

client_signature.description: Ed25519 signature by client over domain separation string michi-link-device-auth-v1||home_id||server_michi_id||client_michi_id||challenge_id||challenge_nonce (86 chars base64url).
